policy: Exceptions keep scanner findings visible and expire unless a named owner renews the evidence. They are not audit suppressions and do not make a vulnerable dependency safe.

exploitPreconditions: An attacker-controlled ZIP archive must reach extract-zip through Puppeteer browser installation or Remotion browser acquisition on a writable host.
compensatingControls: No tracked application source imports extract-zip directly; the policy check fails if such an import is introduced.
Deployed Cloudflare browser workflows launch the platform Browser Rendering binding and do not download or extract user-provided browser archives.
Local and CI browser/video installation must use pinned package-manager dependencies and upstream browser distributions; untrusted ZIP input is prohibited.
evidence: GitHub Dependabot alert 1586 reports no first patched version.
pnpm why extract-zip -r shows only Puppeteer, Cloudflare Puppeteer, and Remotion dependency chains.
scripts/security-advisory-exceptions.mjs verifies expiry, ownership, non-suppression, controls, and absence of direct source imports.
exceptions.removalTrigger: Replace or upgrade the affected dependency immediately when an upstream patched release is available, then delete this exception after the alert closes.
